page.title: Notifications
page.subtitle: Push findings to DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom and other channels · each channel has its own delivery timing and filter rules

global.title: Global settings
global.linkBackHelp: The address the "View details" button in messages points to. Leave empty to omit the button.
global.digestHelp: Only applies to channels in "digest" mode.
global.summaryHelp: Longest finding summary shown in a message, 0–{max}. 0 = no truncation.
global.assetsHelp: Most asset names listed for a finding, 0–{max}. 0 = no truncation (all assets listed).

form.typeLocked: The channel type cannot be changed — a different type means a different set of credentials; create a new channel instead.
form.namePlaceholder: Incident response group / Daily broadcast group
form.noFieldsDefined: The form for this channel type is not defined yet (the frontend is missing a CHANNEL_FIELDS entry); add it and retry.
form.modeDigest: Digest · merged into one message per interval
form.modeHelp: For "realtime for High, digest for the rest", create two channels: one realtime with a High threshold, one digest with no severity limit.
form.rateHelp: Leave empty to use the channel default; 0 means no limit. Going over the limit never drops messages, only delays them.
form.includeHelp: One keyword per line, matched case-insensitively as a substring. Leave empty for all types.
form.excludeHelp: Exclusion beats inclusion: an item matching both is excluded.
form.idsHelp: Empty task/asset = no restriction; when filled, the finding must intersect them.
form.statusChangeLabel: Also push when a finding's status changes (realtime mode only)

toasts.nameRequired: Please fill in a channel name
toasts.testSent: Test message sent ({ms} ms); check the group to confirm
toasts.summaryRangeError: Summary length must be a whole number between 0 and {max}
toasts.assetsRangeError: Assets listed must be a whole number between 0 and {max}

channelForm.saved: Saved · enter a new value to overwrite, clear to remove it
channelForm.savedWithTail: Saved (tail {tail}) · enter a new value to overwrite, clear to remove it

secret.label: Signing secret
secret.help: Fill in when the robot's security settings use 'Sign'; leave empty for 'Custom keywords' or when no security setting is enabled

secret.label: Signature verification secret
secret.help: Fill in when the robot enables 'Signature verification'; otherwise leave empty

headers.label: Custom headers
headers.help: One KEY=VALUE per line, e.g. Authorization=Bearer xxx

body_template.label: Body template
body_template.help: Leave empty to use the built-in default template. Variables: '{{.Title}}' '{{.Batch}}' '{{.Count}}' '{{.HomeURL}}' '{{.SentAt}}', plus .Name/.VulnClass/.Severity/.Summary/.Assets/.DetailURL/.StatusLabel under range .Items. Use '{{json .Xxx}}' instead of '{{.Xxx}}' to insert strings, or quotes in titles will break the JSON.

base_url.label: API URL
base_url.help: Leave empty for the official URL; fill in when proxying a self-hosted Bot API

port.label: Port
port.help: 587 uses STARTTLS; for 465 turn 'Implicit TLS' on

tls.label: Implicit TLS
tls.help: On for port 465; keep off for 587 (STARTTLS is automatic)
